name: Earthquake

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

targets.description: creatures on the ground in a 100-foot-radius circle

summary: A 100-foot-radius tremor: Difficult Terrain, and Dex saves or creatures fall Prone and lose Concentration; it also opens fissures and topples buildings.
text: On casting and at the end of each of your turns, each creature on the ground in the area makes a Dexterity save or is knocked Prone and loses Concentration. You can also open 1d6 fissures (1d10 x 10 feet deep, 10 feet wide; Dex save or fall in) and deal 50 Bludgeoning damage to structures each turn; a collapsing structure forces a Dex save on creatures within half its height (12d6 Bludgeoning, Prone and buried under DC 20 Strength (Athletics) rubble, or half damage only).
